decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered E_S_G200_001A, E_W_G200_001A, Z0_E_W_G200_001A, E_E_G200_001A, E_N_G200_001A, P_02_G200_001A, P_RF_G200_001A, S_BB_G200_001A, Received 6 May 2011, E_S_JA12_001, E_W_G200_001, E_E_JA12_001, E_N_JA12_001, P_00_JA12_001, P_01_JA12_001, P_02_JA12_001, P_02_JA12_001, P_RF_JA12_001, S_BB_JA12_001, Received 16 March 2011, and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - The existing cycle stands at the front of the building shall be maintained and available for use at all times, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - During construction there shall be no access and egress to the site from Gunnersbury Avenue (A406).
description: Erection of an additional storey at third floor level to provide B1(a) office space
